newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Superfos to buy Finnish roadbuilder.
newsitem.headline: Danish Superfos to buy Finnish roadbuilder.

text.p: Danish construction, chemicals and packaging group Superfos said on Thursday it signed a letter of intent with Colas Danmark to acquire Finnish roadbuilder Valtatie Oy for an undisclosed sum.

Superfos said the deal, which meant that it and Colas Danmark would jointly take over Valtatie, Finland's second biggest asphalt company, was subject to the usual diligence stipulations and final agreement on the contract.
Superfos said the planned acquisition was part of its Superfos Construction Europe unit's strategy to expand in new areas of Europe.
Valtatie has an annual turnover of some 180 million crowns with 250 staff, operating mainly in south Finland around the major conurbations of Helsinki, Turku and Tampere, it said in a statement.
